notes.title: We're in the MIX (Indie fan fest)!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello hello!
[/h1][p]First off, a huge thank you to everyone who’s downloaded and played the demo so far. The support from our ever-growing community has been absolutely amazing! We love seeing all your thoughts, feedback, and excitement for Little Corners - please keep them coming and consider joining our Discord community if you’d like to get involved (joining link: [url="https://discord.gg/jy37QZMVU9"]https://discord.gg/jy37QZMVU9[/url]).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683153/657a3050b3a0b28926ced951f1c797843f55464e.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve also had the joy of featuring in some fantastic events recently, including the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45686865/sale/CozyJobSimulators"][u]Cozy Job Simulator[/u][/url] event (which runs until Saturday 27th of September) and the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TGS2025"][u]Tokyo Game Show[/u][/url] online event (which runs until Monday 29th of September. [/p][p][/p][p]Finally, we’ll also be featuring in the MIX Indie Fan Fest (Fall Edition), which goes live tomorrow on Wednesday September 24th - mark your calendars as this’ll be a really exciting showcase with lots of brilliant games.[/p][p][/p][p]Development is going strong, with lots of polish, new corners, and fun refinements based on your feedback. We can’t wait to share more updates soon - thanks for being part of this journey with us![/p][p]
Kirsty, Sam & the team. [/p]

notes.title: gamescom 2025
notes.notes: [p]hello hello![/p][p][/p][p]Firstly, a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to each and every one of you that has wishlisted Little Corners, downloaded the demo, left reviews, joined our discord community, shared your thoughts & suggestions, and most importantly - shared your brilliant corners! We are so grateful for all of the love that came with the demo and I can’t wait to see more from you, and share more with you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683153/58598df217b50e796b5216ae68ec9fb35946801a.png"][/img][/p][p]Development is going great, when we're not distracted by building frog-based corners... And we wanted to let you know that we will be at [b]gamescom next week![/b] Little Corners will be part of this years [b]Indie Arena Booth at[/b] [b]stand S35 in Hall 10.2[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]If you're heading to Gamescom, why not pop by and have a play (there will be a heap of real-life stickers to give away as well)👀👀👀[/p][p][/p][p]Kirsty🐸[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to the Little Corners Demo!
notes.notes: [p]Howdy Friends! [/p][p]After a month of hard work and iteration of feedback, we're really pleased to be bringing a hot new demo to Steam! This demo has some new features that have been requested by the community, as well as a new room, the Astronomer's Tower. Drop us a review here on Steam and let us know in [url="https://discord.gg/nvYS6cm488"]Discord [/url]if you think we [i]stuck[/i] the landing! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Astronomer's Tower![/b][/h2][p]The Islamic Golden Age of the 8th-13th centuries inspires the new Astronomer's Tower, and features telescopes, workbooks, and maths equipment to decorate your room with! [/p][p]This being a Little Corner though, we also had to show our love for the frog gang so of course there's a new frog, amongst some other cute animals (see if you can spot them in the screenshot below!). Let us know your favourite new addition in our [url="https://discord.gg/jy37QZMVU9"]Discord [/url]👀[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683153/e449ce7672a360a2d9b1f89838ed6daca4b7e93a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Demo Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Two Little Corners[/b] to decorate to your heart's content - The Alchemist's Lab and The Astronomer's Tower.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save and Load[/b] - A much-requested feature, we're happy to say you can now save and name your corners to play across multiple sessions! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Undo and Redo[/b] - Another feature you've been asking for, you can find it now in the build mapped to the 'Z' and 'Y' keys respectively. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Two original lo-fi tunes[/b] to vibe to[/p][/*][*][p][b]400+ stickers[/b] to peel, place, and play with[/p][/*][*][p]Customisable worktops[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Trailer[/h2][p]We're also really happy to share our new trailer with you! Over on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/littlecornersgame.bsky.social"]BlueSky [/url]we're looking to promote some other wholesome games and share what people are working on out there, so come on over and take a look![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="HLTkqyyEu6U;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Later this month we'll be hitting the road and taking Little Corners to Gamescom. If you're planning to attend, come find us at the Indie Arena Booth! Please jump into our friendly community of sticker addicts and share your creations and feedback with us in [url="https://discord.gg/nvYS6cm488"]Discord[/url]! Follow us on socials to keep up to date with future updates and content. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Sophie ☁️[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]PS[/i][/b][i]: we will be attempting to use as many puns as possible everywhere and in everything, so let us know if you have any sticker-related ones we can use![/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/nvYS6cm488" style="button"]Join The Discord[/url] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/littlecornersgame.bsky.social" style="button"]BlueSky[/url] [url="https://x.com/little_corners_" style="button"]X/Twitter[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/littlecornersgame/" style="button"]Instagram[/url] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@littlecornersgame" style="button"]TikTok[/url][/p]

notes.title: 1,000 Wishlists & Upcoming Demo!
notes.notes: [p]Hello Friends! [/p][p]We've been [b]so [/b]excited to hear the feedback so far on our game, Little Corners! The feedback has been so positive and we're so glad to see some of you [i]sticking[/i] around in our Discord! We're excited to bring two updates your way. Firstly, we're excited to be bringing a fresh demo to Steam. [/p][p][/p][h1][b]New Room On Its Way![/b][/h1][p]The new demo that is arriving next week will feature a new room, which we'll be sharing a bit more of in the coming days, as well as a range of QoL features like Undo/Redo buttons and general optimisations. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Demo Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Two Little Corners[/b] to decorate to your heart's content[/p][/*][*][p][b]Original lo-fi tunes[/b] to bop along to[/p][/*][*][p][b]250+ stickers[/b] to choose from[/p][/*][*][p]Customisable worktops[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683153/a52a04d0c3526536ffccbbc05a9a73c7c70b2b25.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Secondly, we're also very excited to share that we've surpassed 1,000 Wishlists, which frankly, is amazing! Thank you for the support, and please keep spreading the word to friends and family, it makes a huge difference. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683153/1b7167c66500469cc470424db97f3913a1c7dd7f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're going to stick to our guns and keep working on new content, new features and optimisation as we prepare for launch and more opportunities for you to get your hands on the game! Come join our friendly community and share your creations with us in [url="https://discord.gg/nvYS6cm488"]Discord[/url]! Follow us on socials to keep up to date with future updates and content. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Sophie ☁️[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]PS[/i][/b][i]: we will be attempting to use as many puns as possible everywhere and in everything, so let us know if you have any sticker-related ones we can use![/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/nvYS6cm488" style="button"]Join The Discord[/url] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/littlecornersgame.bsky.social" style="button"]BlueSky[/url] [url="https://x.com/little_corners_" style="button"]X/Twitter[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/littlecornersgame/" style="button"]Instagram[/url] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@littlecornersgame" style="button"]TikTok[/url][/p]
